title: Send a JSON object
summary: Gin: Send a JSON object. Add a pages field.
introduction: gin.H is a short map type for named data. Open GET /book. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Send a JSON object with Gin

blocks.text: Create a practice folder, run go mod init school and go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin@v1.10.0. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Send a JSON object

blocks.text: gin.H creates a named map. JSON serialises it and writes the requested status.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use c.JSON so the response has the right content type.
